projects.title: Pipeline defect detection system
projects.summary: Finds cracks and weld defects on pipelines from camera images and flags them for the inspector.
projects.problem: Pipeline welds are checked by eye. Small cracks and defects are easy to miss, and every inspector judges a little differently.
approach: A detection model marks cracks and weld defects on each image or live camera frame
Every finding gets a box and a confidence score, so the inspector can confirm it quickly
Results are saved as a report the team can export
projects.result: Working prototype, shown on images and a live camera. Code is in the repository.

media.caption: 3D illustration of a pipeline inspection station, with a real crack detection in the corner.

extra.caption: Real crack detection on a pipe weld: the model boxes the crack running across the weld bead.

projects.title: Parcel counting on a conveyor
projects.summary: Counts every parcel that crosses a line on a moving belt, with a live rate per hour and alerts when the belt runs empty.
projects.problem: Warehouses and packing lines need an accurate throughput count, and people miss parcels when the belt is busy.
approach: Pretrained object detector finds each parcel in the camera view
Each parcel is tracked with an ID so it is counted once as it crosses the count line
Live rate per hour, a gap flag when the belt is empty for more than 2.5 s, and an event log of every count
projects.result: Demo on real conveyor footage with an open, pretrained model. Not a client system. See the video.

media.caption: Demo reel: tracked parcels, the count line, live rate, gap flags and event log. No audio.

projects.title: Weld defect detection
projects.summary: Finds porosity, undercut and lack of fusion on weld seams and returns boxes through an API.
projects.problem: Visual weld inspection is slow and inconsistent between inspectors, and small pores are easy to miss.
approach: Annotated weld images for porosity, spatter, undercut, lack of fusion and good welds
Trained a custom YOLOv8 model with augmentation
FastAPI endpoint returns boxes, labels and confidences for any uploaded image
projects.result: About 90% mAP on the project validation set, as reported in the repository.

media.caption: 3D illustration of a weld seam with porosity and undercut marked, with a real porosity detection in the corner.

extra.caption: Real porosity detection on a weld bead: the model boxes the row of gas pores (confidence 0.70).

projects.title: Flange and disk dimension check
projects.summary: Measures a part with one camera and an ArUco marker, then checks it against tolerance.
projects.problem: Checking flange and disk dimensions with calipers is slow and does not leave a record.
approach: ArUco marker of known size gives a mm-per-pixel scale for the frame
Contour and circle detection for outer/inner diameter, bolt circle and hole count
Values compared with a tolerance table to return PASS or FAIL
Depth-estimation variant tested for tilted camera angles
projects.result: Working measurement demo on real parts (see video). PASS/FAIL against a tolerance table in the full system.

media.caption: Flange with OD, ID and bolt circle measured against a scale marker. (Illustration)

projects.title: Paint surface defect detection
projects.summary: Flags peeling paint, pin holes, stains and rough areas so inspectors go straight to problem spots.
projects.problem: Surface inspection of painted walls and panels relies on someone walking the whole area.
approach: Annotated classes: stain marks, pin holes, rough/pitted surface, peeling paint
YOLO detector trained on the annotated set
Runs on images and video
projects.result: Detects all four classes on test images; dense small defects such as pin holes are picked out individually.

media.caption: Wall surface with peeling paint, a crack and pin holes marked. (Illustration)

projects.title: HR recruitment and onboarding workflow
projects.summary: An LLM workflow that takes applications through screening, shortlisting and onboarding.
projects.problem: Recruiters spend most of their time reading applications and moving candidates between steps by hand.
approach: Parse applications into structured candidate profiles
Score each profile against the role criteria with an LLM and keep the reasoning
Shortlist for a human decision; nothing is rejected automatically
Hand accepted candidates into an onboarding checklist
Give the HR team one dashboard: a live funnel, an interview tracker with scheduling, and interviewer forms for each round
projects.result: Being rolled out with the operations team at a manufacturer, as part of my current role. Implementation details are private.

media.caption: Hiring overview, live funnel and AI scorecard, recreated with made-up data. The real platform is private.

extra.caption: Interview tracker: every candidate, their round (L1 to L3) and interviewer forms on one list. Recreated with made-up data.

projects.title: Resume screening and job matching
projects.summary: Classifies resumes by role and recommends matching jobs.
projects.problem: Large resume pools need a first pass that sorts candidates by role.
approach: Cleaning and visualising the resume dataset
Text features plus classical ML and deep learning models
Job recommendation from the predicted role
projects.result: Notebook study comparing models for resume-to-role classification.

projects.title: RAG pipeline (FAISS + FLAN-T5)
projects.summary: A small, readable retrieval-augmented generation pipeline.
projects.problem: Language models answer confidently without sources.
approach: MPNet sentence embeddings
FAISS vector index for search
FLAN-T5 answers only from the retrieved passages
projects.result: End-to-end pipeline written to be easy to read and extend.

media.caption: Documents to embeddings to FAISS search to grounded answer. (Illustration)

projects.title: Voice emotion detection
projects.summary: Listens to a short voice clip and tells you the speaker's emotion: happy, sad, angry, fear, disgust or neutral.
projects.problem: Call centres and voice assistants hear thousands of conversations, but nobody can listen to all of them to catch an angry or upset caller in time.
approach: Speech turned into MFCC audio features and standardised
A deep learning model classifies six emotions from those features
Checked with a confusion matrix, plus a small app to test your own clips
projects.result: Working model and demo app. Code and notebook are in the repository.

media.caption: Voice clip to MFCC features to emotion scores. (Illustration)

projects.title: Subtitle and transcription SaaS
projects.summary: Multilingual subtitles, transcription and translation for a media team.
projects.problem: Manual transcription and translation of video was slow and expensive.
approach: Whisper for transcription with timestamps
LLM translation of segments
FFmpeg to export subtitle files and burn-ins
projects.result: Used in production at a digital media company, cutting manual translation effort by about 40%. Code is private.

projects.title: n8n reporting automations
projects.summary: Scheduled workflows that pull data, build reports and notify the team.
projects.problem: Weekly reporting meant copying numbers between tools by hand.
approach: n8n workflows on a schedule
APIs and Google Apps Script for data
Feeds Power BI / Looker dashboards; reports and notifications sent automatically
projects.result: Used day to day at a digital media company. Code is private.

projects.title: Tomato ripeness grading
projects.summary: Grades each tomato on the vine as ripe, turning or unripe in real time.
projects.problem: Harvest planning needs to know how much fruit is ripe now and how much is close.
approach: YOLOv8 tomato model with three ripeness classes
ByteTrack keeps one ID per fruit so counts do not double
Class-aware duplicate suppression
projects.result: Runs at roughly 75–85 ms per frame on CPU on real footage.

media.caption: Real-time ripeness grading on greenhouse footage. Open YOLOv8 tomato model on CPU; boxes from the actual run.

projects.title: AI-driven smart farming system (IEEE Access)
projects.summary: Final-year project: soil analysis, irrigation advice and crop-fertilizer recommendations, published in IEEE Access.
projects.problem: Farmers lack personalised, data-driven advice on soil health, irrigation and which crop and fertilizer to use.
approach: IoT soil sensors (moisture, temperature, NPK) plus a weather API
Transformer-based tabular learning (TTL) for irrigation advice
TabNet with explainable-AI for soil analysis and fertilizer; SwiFT transformer for crop recommendation
Web app with a chatbot for farmers
projects.result: Reported in the paper: irrigation advice 99.13% accuracy, crop recommendation 98.75%, fertilizer recommendation 99.3%, soil analysis R² 0.987.

media.caption: System overview with the accuracies reported in the paper. (Illustration)

projects.title: Potato leaf disease CNN
projects.summary: Classifies potato leaves as early blight, late blight or healthy.
projects.problem: Blight spreads quickly; early identification from a phone photo helps growers act in time.
approach: Leaf image dataset with three classes
Preprocessing and augmentation
Convolutional network in TensorFlow/Keras
Evaluation on held-out images
projects.result: Validation accuracy above 95% by the final epochs (see training curves); correct, high-confidence predictions on held-out leaves.

media.caption: Predictions on held-out leaves, with true labels. From the project notebook.

extra.caption: Training and validation accuracy and loss over 25 epochs, from the notebook.

projects.problem: Yield estimates usually come from manual sampling.
approach: YOLO detector on orchard video
Per-frame detections with confidences
projects.result: Demo on real footage; see the video.

projects.title: Poultry count and crowding alarm
projects.summary: Counts birds live and raises an alarm when they crowd.
projects.problem: Crowding causes stress and losses, and nobody watches the camera all day.
approach: YOLOv8 detection of each bird
Distance check between birds to find close pairs
Alarm when crowding passes a threshold
projects.result: Demo on real footage; see the video.

media.caption: Live count and close-pair check on real farm footage.

projects.title: AI-powered medicine recommendation
projects.summary: Suggests treatment options from patient symptoms, with a local medicine database and an external API as fallback.
projects.problem: Looking up suitable medicines by hand is slow, and a lookup table alone misses conditions it does not list.
approach: Symptom, description, diet, medication and precaution datasets prepared with Pandas and NumPy
Scikit-learn classifier trained on symptoms to predict the likely condition
Local medicine database checked first; an external medical API is queried for conditions not found
Results ranked and returned through a FastAPI service and a simple web page, packaged with Docker
projects.result: Working prototype. No accuracy figure is claimed. It is decision support for learning and demos, not medical advice. Planned: drug interaction checks and better symptom language handling.

media.caption: Patient input to ranked options, with a database lookup and API fallback. (Illustration)

projects.title: Invoice to Excel tool
projects.summary: Turns invoices into a clean Excel sheet, so nobody retypes them by hand.
projects.problem: Finance teams copy invoice fields into spreadsheets by hand. It is slow and easy to get wrong.
approach: Invoice fields extracted into one fixed table structure
Exported as an Excel file ready for accounts
Deployed as a public Streamlit web app
projects.result: Live as a web app. Code is private.

media.caption: Invoice in, structured rows out, exported to Excel. (Illustration)
